name: capacity_20261007_vslo
note: Per-replica open-loop capacity of the current engine (vLLM 0.30 patched image, chat completions, ignore_eos), shape in 492 / out 400. v_b = open-loop knee (tok/s, in+out), v_p = prefill-only knee; v_d is derived (in/v_p + out/v_d = 892/v_b), see tracegen.capacity. knee_ttft_s / knee_tpot_s = mean TTFT / TPOT per request at the knee rate, linearly interpolated between the two open-loop steps around v_b/892 req/s; used only for the audit's in-flight (Little's law) and route-timeout estimates. Re-derive (and re-generate every trace) after any engine / theta change. 2026-10-07: rho = 1 re-defined at V_slo = calibration.factor x v_b (see calibration); v_b / v_p / knee_* are unchanged knee values (they still set v_d and the route-timeout out_max).
source: baseline-params-20261006: profile-knee/profile.yaml (v_b 7b, v_p all; v_b 8b/14b from profile-openloop knee search as in trace-audit-20261007 sec. 2), profile-openloop/raw/*_i492_o400_r*.jsonl (TTFT/TPOT means)

route_cap.rule: out_max[m] = floor((frac * timeout_s - knee_p95_ttft_s[m]) / knee_p95_tpot_s[m]): an output that long still finishes inside 80 % of the 150 s route timeout at the knee's p95 TTFT / TPOT; applied as the upper truncation of every output length (synthetic and real)
route_cap.knee_step_rule: the open-loop 492/400 step whose tok/s defines v_b; for 8b / 14b that step is in profile-openloop, because their profile-knee steps (8.88 / 8.52 req/s) were unbounded queues (TTFT p95 10.5 s / 3.4 s) and do not define v_b

calibration.rule: frozen 2026-10-07 (docs/trace-design-v2.md, 10-07 13:00 标定错误): rho = 1 per replica at V_slo = the highest open-loop step whose requests (lengths drawn from the traces own distribution: tracegen lognormal + route-timeout out cap; chat, ignore_eos, one awake replica) have TTFT p95 <= 500 ms and TPOT p95 <= 75 ms; factor = V_slo / V_b; every trace req/s x factor (cost / factor), rho shapes unchanged; Real-* v1 count factors x factor
calibration.source: baseline-params-20261006/profile-vslo-20261007 (profile.yaml mu, profile_raw.csv; tokenscale_profile --trace-lengths specs/Steady.json @ aibrix 478b02bf, steps 0.30..1.00 x v_b/892 req/s by 0.05, 130 s steps / 30 s warm-up)
calibration.length_distribution: synthetic default (every synthetic spec default: lognormal conv2023 sigma, in mean 492 min 32, out mean 400, out_max route cap); applied to all traces incl. Prefill_mix / Decode_burst (time-varying means) and Real-* (v1 lengths): one factor per model
